definitions.explanation: A device that heats water for household use.

examples.japanese: {給湯器|きゅうとうき}が{故障|こしょう}した。
{新|あたら}しい{給湯器|きゅうとうき}に{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: I replaced it with a new water heater.

examples.japanese: {給湯器|きゅうとうき}のスイッチを{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To turn on the water heater.

notes: Essential household equipment in Japan. Types include gas ({ガス}{給湯器|きゅうとうき}) and electric ({電気|でんき}{給湯器|きゅうとうき}). Many Japanese homes have on-demand tankless water heaters.
